extraction.agency_name: Office of the Register of Wills

findings.title: The Office had not established adequate controls to ensure that inheritance taxes were accurately calculated and paid.
findings.description: The Office lacked adequate controls for accurate tax calculation/payment, resulting in errors in 4 of 19 estates reviewed. Testing disclosed 3 estates underpaid inheritance taxes by approximately $46,000 and 1 estate overpaid by approximately $9,000 during the audit period.

dollar_amounts.context: inheritance taxes collected during audit period

findings.recommendation: We recommend that the Office develop and implement adequate and documented procedures for ensuring that all inheritance taxes due are accurately calculated and paid in accordance with State law.

extraction.agency_response_summary: The Office's response to findings and recommendations is included as an appendix to this report.
